title: Marking a task complete survives a page reload
note: Demo app BUG-2. The checkbox handler updates the DOM optimistically and never posts to the server, so the completed state resets on reload. Deliberate — do not fix. See demo-app/KNOWN_BUGS.md.

title: Deleting a task removes the task that was clicked
note: Demo app BUG-1. POST /tasks/delete resolves the task by matching on `text` instead of the submitted `id`, so with two tasks sharing the same text the wrong one is removed. Deliberate — do not fix. See demo-app/KNOWN_BUGS.md.

title: Submitting an empty task is rejected
note: Demo app BUG-3. POST /tasks/add has no validation on the client or the server, so an empty submission creates a blank task. Deliberate — do not fix. See demo-app/KNOWN_BUGS.md.
